course.name: Debugging and Observability
course.description: Trace a wrong value to its source and prove the repair.
course.longDescription: 35 minutes required. Prerequisites: Thinking in Flows and Events. Build a harmless broken text flow from a supplied fixture, inspect evidence, change one producer and test the complete invocation path. Release and Rollback covers snapshots and production promotion.

modules.title: Build and check
modules.description: Complete the practical steps and inspect the result.

challenges.prompt: The run is green but prints MIXED CASE instead of mixed case. What does green establish?
challenges.explanation: Execution completed; correctness still requires comparison with the expected result.

options.label: Execution completed; correctness still requires comparison with the expected result.
The normalization requirement was satisfied.
The input could not have affected the result.

challenges.prompt: A sending node rejects an empty body supplied by an upstream transform. Where should investigation continue?
challenges.explanation: Follow the Body data input to the producer and inspect the value there.

options.label: Replace the sending node immediately.
Ignore pure nodes because they have no execution wires.
Follow the Body data input to the producer and inspect the value there.

lessons.title: Keep evidence that answers a question

challenges.prompt: An Info line disappears after selecting the Error filter. What should you conclude?
challenges.explanation: The viewer filtered that line; inspect recording settings separately.

options.label: Every historic run has been deleted.
The viewer filtered that line; inspect recording settings separately.
The associated node no longer exists.

lessons.title: Test boundaries and the actual Event

challenges.prompt: The repaired draft passes but a pinned Event still runs the old behavior. What should you inspect?
challenges.explanation: The Event’s target version and the planned release/repoint step.

options.label: The Event’s target version and the planned release/repoint step.
Whether the fixture filename contains spaces.
Whether the success log is long enough.

modules.title: Apply it
modules.description: Use the result to solve a new case.

challenges.prompt: The final log prints the correct words with unwanted spaces. Which evidence best locates the cause?
challenges.explanation: The values before and after the intended trimming stage.

options.label: The app display name.
The order of unrelated Event records.
The values before and after the intended trimming stage.

challenges.prompt: A repaired fixture passes, but a previously working input fails. What should happen next?
challenges.explanation: Investigate the regression before promoting the repair.

options.label: Remove the previously working fixture.
Investigate the regression before promoting the repair.
Promote because the original failure is gone.

challenges.prompt: Replaying a historic request would send a second invoice. How should you reproduce safely?
challenges.explanation: Use a scratch target or disabled side effect while preserving the input needed for diagnosis.

options.label: Use a scratch target or disabled side effect while preserving the input needed for diagnosis.
Replay against production because the input is historic.
Delete the historic evidence.
